break_even_contract.required_inequality: cumulative_received_funding > spot_maker_entry_fee + spot_maker_exit_fee + futures_taker_entry_fee + futures_taker_exit_fee + entry_basis_and_spread + exit_basis_and_spread + capital_liquidation_and_operational_costs
break_even_contract.reason: the current public product surface did not expose a live portfolio rate or any subsidy that changes the already rejected matched-base funding-carry economics

official_mechanism.legs: equal-notional spot and opposite perpetual positions
official_mechanism.liquidation_risk: mark-price divergence and repeated opposite funding can consume margin and cause liquidation
official_mechanism.negative_initial_pnl_expected: fees and spread can make PnL negative immediately after subscription
official_mechanism.published_entry_exit_fees: spot maker fees plus futures taker fees on subscription and redemption, account VIP dependent
official_mechanism.strategy_end_on_funding_reversal: manual; alerts do not close the strategy

limitations: No current portfolio catalog rate exact symbol fee schedule spread basis fill owned funding history liquidation buffer or capital cost was available from the logged-out product surface.
Trailing three-day funding or a displayed APR cannot prove forward persistence across funding reversals and stressed basis regimes.
Automation of the same spot-perpetual legs is operational packaging, not a new payoff identity or market-independent subsidy.
The frozen Round 61 matched-base BTC ETH and SOL replay already failed capacity and after-cost economic gates; no material new source evidence reopens it.
prohibited_actions: treating the delta-neutral label as market-invariant risk-free or liquidation-proof
crediting displayed trailing APR without exact current fees spread basis capital and persistence
using leverage or reinvestment to turn a rejected gross mechanism into an edge
opening subscribing redeeming or closing a Smart Arbitrage strategy without separate funded trading authority
rerunning Round 61 or resampling ordinary spot-perpetual funding carry without a material fee execution or capital subsidy

retry_policy.reopen_only_for: a newly published material fee rebate execution guarantee principal subsidy or capital credit unique to Smart Arbitrage that changes the frozen matched-base break-even identity
retry_policy.signed_account_access: not justified while the public mechanism remains the same terminal family
retry_policy.trading_authority: always separately required for subscription redemption or any position change
